observations: Two inward-facing people flank a large upright wheel on a bench. The right hand visibly overlaps its opposite tyre edge; the left hand wraps around a gold tool.
Both visible hands have continuous, separately attributable forearms and sleeve connections. Simplified anatomy remains readable at 768 by 512.

The upper-left tyre contact forms a small near-closed dark loop with pale inner space and a yellow tool tip. At intended size this reads more readily as a loop perched against the wheel than as a clearly lifted tyre lip with a lever underneath it.
Muted cream workshop fixtures recede behind teal and rust clothing and the dark wheel. The scene contains no text.
The target closely matches the candidate's composition, silhouettes and palette, but its upper-left lifted segment has a more open lower contour.

image_actions.returned: Displayed full artwork image; independently observed composition, arm ownership and tyre-contact contours.
Displayed intended-size artwork image; independently observed collaborative scene readability and ambiguous lever-under-edge relationship.
Displayed target image; independently observed matching scene and more open lifted-segment contour.

brief.reason: Cooperation, removed wheel, tool grip, separate support hand and arm ownership are readable. The decisive tyre-lever-under-edge action remains ambiguous at intended size because its contact is presented as a compact loop.

composition.reason: The dominant wheel, opposing profiles and converging arms establish a clear focal scene. Spacious background and broad bench keep the action organized at intended size.

alignment.reason: Bench, wheel and opposing figures have stable optical relationships. Background fixtures stay outside the central action without distracting crowding.

typography.reason: Wordless illustration with no required or visible text.

color.reason: Cream, teal, rust and dark blue-green form a coherent restrained palette. The gold lever is identifiable, and workshop context recedes appropriately.

style.reason: Flat silhouettes, simplified profiles and sparse contours form a coherent editorial language. Outlines concentrate on the hands and repair components where explanation is needed.

distinctiveness.reason: The repair subject is specific, but the nearly mirrored bust figures, generic background fixtures and static poses make the overall concept feel interchangeable. Its most distinctive subject detail, the lifted tyre segment, is also its least clear.

craft.reason: Clean silhouettes and separated spokes scale well, and inspection reports native vector objects. The local layering of gold hook, pale cutout and curled dark tyre contour does not produce a sufficiently clear contact relationship.

visual_fidelity.reason: Candidate closely retains the target's wheel scale, opposing figures, bench, muted atmosphere, clothing colors and arm placements. The more closed lifted-segment contour is a local departure that weakens action clarity without changing the overall direction.

copy_assessment.reason: No copy is required or present; the communication burden belongs to the illustration.

findings.location: Upper-left wheel edge, gold lever and lifted tyre segment; approximately native x609–697, y370–460
findings.evidence: At 768 by 512, the dark lifted segment reads as a small near-closed ring attached to the outside of the wheel. The gold tip becomes a yellow patch inside this ring, rather than an unmistakable hook passing beneath a continuous tyre edge.
findings.impact: The audience can recognize joint wheel work but cannot confidently identify the particular tyre-lever action required by the brief.
findings.fix: Redraw this local contact as an open lifted lip that visibly continues into the main tyre contour. Show a clear stretch of gold shaft entering beneath that lip and use a simple overlap to distinguish tyre above, tool below and exposed rim.

findings.evidence: The figures share similarly upright inward profiles and neutral expressions, while the wall fixtures and bench objects are very generic.
findings.impact: The scene communicates its category but conveys limited character or workshop-specific editorial personality.
findings.fix: After resolving contact, introduce one purposeful asymmetry, such as a slight working-person lean toward the levering point or a helper gaze directed toward the contact, while preserving the simple silhouettes and focal separation.

comparison.reason: No incumbent or original artwork was supplied. The target is a fidelity reference, not a retained baseline.

brief_comparison.reason: Initial common-brief assessment with no incumbent or original to compare.

regression.evidence: No retained baseline exists, so no consequential loss versus prior artwork can be established.

summary: The wordless cooperation scene is readable and coherently art-directed, with plausible separate arm ownership. It remains unfinished against the locked brief because the small curled contact does not clearly communicate a tyre lever beneath a lifted edge at intended size. Resolve that local silhouette and layering before treating the specific repair action as fully communicated.
